So, what David says is that Yahweh is our God and our God is better than the other gods. The Bible aims to explain who Yahweh is and why he is a superior god compared to all others.

When you centralize religion around a temple, like David did by building one in Jerusalem, you create jobs for Egyptian priests who become your main political allies.

The third significant action was initiating the creation of the Bible. This mythology explains Israelite origins, their uniqueness, and their superiority over other people. The Bible starts with Genesis, which means "beginning" or "birth."

In Genesis, God creates the universe, feels lonely, and forms Adam from dust. To alleviate loneliness, he creates Eve.

God breathes life into Adam and plants a garden in Eden. This garden has trees—the tree of life grants immortality, while the tree of knowledge of good and evil provides learning.

These two trees represent knowledge and survival. Without the ability to learn through experiences like hitting a metaphorical wall, one cannot understand what is good or bad. Schooling, by shielding students from making mistakes, limits this essential learning process.

Thus, creativity and immortality together enable one to become God-like, absorbing all knowledge over a lifetime. This aligns with the idea that once perfect, no more learning is necessary.
